title: Pardons Christopher II X
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Christopher II X as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s clemency list identifies Christopher II X among people Trump pardoned on December 23, 2020, not May 24, 2018 as the input date states. The listing connects the pardon to five federal cases, including a cocaine-distribution conspiracy and later probation violations. The date conflict should be corrected before treating this as a May 2018 event.
description_long: The Justice Department’s official list places Christopher II X in the section for pardons granted on December 23, 2020, which conflicts with this entry’s May 24, 2018 date. The table lists five federal matters: a conspiracy to distribute cocaine in the Eastern District of Arkansas and four subsequent violations associated with cases in Indiana, Arkansas, and Kentucky. It records prison terms imposed from 1985 through 1992, including a three-year term and five years’ probation in the first case; the pardon table does not explain the later clemency decision or give its terms beyond identifying a pardon. The source therefore provides substantially more context than the entry title, but it also shows that the event date in the input is wrong. The record should be corrected to December 23, 2020 before it is treated as a 2018 pardon. The clemency list establishes the date and listed convictions; it does not supply the administration’s rationale or a detailed account of the pardon’s effect.
